descriptionIntro: Coheed and Cambria's first album names its characters right in the lyrics. The twins, Patrick, Newo and her dog Apollo, even the two guys flying the spaceship. Part 2 of our Amory Wars series goes through The Second Stage Turbine Blade one track at a time, with the comics each song lines up with. No spoilers past this album.
pinnedComment: Favorite track on The Second Stage Turbine Blade? Mine is a tie between about five of them. And if you read the 2007 comics when they came out, what did you think?
